Wire.comment: Reified cross-document Wire Meaningful Object. ONE wire:Wire subject per wire in the :projection:workspace named graph, minted as workspace_entity_subject(graph_id, "wire", id). Code-defined span (rdf_wire_materializer::wire_subject_triples = the rdf:type head + push_wire_triples body) — this contract is the AUTHORED mirror of that span, used to DERIVE the SHACL conformance shapes. SINGLE CLASS, flat (~24 predicates), fully DERIVED. DANGLING ENDPOINTS ARE ALLOWED BY DESIGN: sourceDocument/targetDocument/sourceBlock/targetBlock/sourceContext/targetContext are sh:nodeKind sh:IRI (they ARE IRIs) but the shapes DELIBERATELY do NOT enforce referential integrity (sh:class) — a wire may reference a document/block that does not exist (proven by oracle_dangling_endpoint_still_emitted_w1). Endpoint-consistency would be a hand-authored complement, NOT part of these shapes. Only rdf:type + wire:targetGraph are always-emitted; every other predicate is required:false (construction-driven, present only when the source field is present).

wire:sourceDocument.comment: endpoint IRI — referential integrity NOT enforced (may dangle)

wire:targetDocument.comment: endpoint IRI — referential integrity NOT enforced (may dangle)

wire:targetGraph.comment: ALWAYS emitted (defaults to graph_id when targetGraphId absent) — the one required non-type predicate

mdoc:createdAt.comment: the ONE non-wire-namespace predicate (push_wire_triples emits createdAt under MDOC_NS)

comment: EA-2b+ SHACL retrofit contract for the WIRE Meaningful Object (structural fork: the no-referential-integrity note). NOT a served emporium pack — an AUTHORED mirror of the code-defined wire_subject_triples span, whose sole consumer is vocab_to_shacl. wire: is the runtime WIRE_NS (http://mnemosyne.ai/vocab#) — the namespace the materializer mints rdf:type mnemo:Wire AND the wire:* predicates under (the gardend MNEMO vocab prefix). primary_prefix=wire so wire:Wire is the shape target. mdoc: is MDOC_NS (the single createdAt exception). The flat closed shape is COMPLETE and CORRECT for wires; the only structural subtlety is what it must NOT do — enforce endpoint existence.
description: A reified cross-document wire: rdf:type wire:Wire plus endpoint IRIs (source/target document/block/context — referential integrity unenforced), the predicate, optional bidirectional/inverseOf, the always-on targetGraph, and scene/temporal scalar metadata.
